_comment: Model manifest for Fluid Motion serverless workers. All paths are relative to /runpod-volume/models/.

checkpoint.name: animagine-xl-4.0.safetensors
checkpoint.description: Animagine XL 4.0 — high-quality anime SDXL checkpoint. Strong prompt adherence, consistent anatomy, vibrant colors.
checkpoint.notes: House model. Do NOT add additional base checkpoints — use LoRAs for style variants.

vae.name: sdxl_vae.safetensors
vae.description: Fixed SDXL VAE for consistent color/contrast output.

watercolor.name: watercolor_style_sdxl.safetensors
watercolor.description: Ghibli-adjacent soft watercolor + warm lighting style LoRA.
watercolor.notes: Applied when style='watercolor' (default). Light enough to not distort base anatomy.

cyberpunk.name: cyberpunk_style_sdxl.safetensors
cyberpunk.notes: Applied when style='cyberpunk'. Can combine with darker negative prompts for noir variant.

upscaler.name: 4x-UltraSharp.pth
upscaler.description: 4x upscaler for final mode. Sharp, preserves anime linework.

standard.name: ltx-video
standard.description: LTX Video — budget image-to-video model. Good motion quality, reasonable VRAM.
standard.notes: Default tier. Use for all standard video generation requests.

premium.name: minimax-h3-max
premium.description: Minimax H3 Max — premium cinematic video generation.
premium.notes: Premium tier. Only triggered by explicit user request or Diva hero shots.
